actionLog: Reproduced live with Playwright (real data/+client/ servers, throwaway dev user): the dropdown's z-index was trapped inside its own .ticket-row's stacking context, since that row establishes one via opacity:0 + animation:...forwards on its entrance fade - so any later sibling row painted fully over the open dropdown, matching 'hidden behind other requirements'. Fixed by portaling the dropdown to document.body (position:fixed, positioned from the trigger's live bounding rect), matching the codebase's existing modal/overlay portal convention; also had to patch the close-on-blur check, which relied on a real-DOM .contains() that no longer sees the portaled dropdown as contained. PR #67 also covers ann-mt8ih0xavev6 (a closely related, same-ticket follow-up comment filed 2 minutes later asking for the same control in the ticket detail modal) in one PR since it's the same component/fix area.
